pattern: ends the turn with a manual step in plain text while t3_background_wait holds the thread
experience: A Claude turn marked a background command awaited with t3_background_wait, then told the user in plain text to sign in by hand. The thread showed only 'Waiting' in the sidebar's Working group, with nothing saying it was blocked on the user.
rule: When the user must act by hand before awaited work can finish (sign in, approve, plug in a device), ask with AskUserQuestion; plain text leaves the thread showing only Waiting.
